invariant: REPORT_QUEUED means generation is pending and ready to be started. It does not mean generation is actively executing. 'already_active' may only be returned when an attempt is genuinely REPORT_GENERATING.
method: Every condition runs against the real claim_manual_report_generation RPC using disposable fixtures inside a plpgsql exception block, which rolls the fixtures back while the collected results survive. Verified afterwards: 0 surviving MKORD-GATE-% orders.

results.description: QUEUED with nothing executing allows manual Generate
results.defectThisCatches: The reported defect: payment confirmation queued an attempt, nothing drained it, and manual Generate was rejected as generation_already_active forever.

results.description: Adoption reuses the queued attempt, no duplicate
results.defectThisCatches: A fix that sidestepped the queued row by creating a second attempt would leave two attempts and two report versions for one paid order.

results.description: REPORT_GENERATING is still rejected as already active
results.defectThisCatches: Concurrency protection removed rather than corrected.

results.description: Second claim after adoption is rejected, not double-adopted
results.defectThisCatches: Two concurrent Generate requests adopting the same row, where the loser would mark the winner's in-flight attempt as failed.

results.description: Adoption completes the start transition and reports it
results.defectThisCatches: The first corrected build: the claim moved the row to REPORT_GENERATING, then start_manual_report_generation -- which only moves a REPORT_QUEUED row -- rejected it and failed the generation at stage start_generation.

results.description: Normal path still creates a QUEUED attempt for the start RPC
results.defectThisCatches: Regression in the ordinary generate path, which must still create a QUEUED attempt and let the start RPC own the transition.
